        `expected_value` is given (a string, or a tuple/list of alternates),
        assert it appears in the reply — the logged value renders as its own
        bolded span in the success message (e.g. "Your **40 oz** ... logged"),
        so this is a direct, deterministic check rather than a semantic one.
        """
        self.send_message(answer)
